timeMapping.scopeKnots: [local source-study beat, new global tour beat]

observation.offsetOwnership: Native source poses + mechanically derived model wrappers + independent reversible display offsets. Gear demonstration returns source teeth to native meshing placements before motion.

gearGather.rule: Multiply the current whole-level gear display offset by 1-gather; keep original mechanical source placements while operating.

workingMotion.runtimeOwner: kinematics.workingPoses -> viewer model wrappers; poses are parent-relative deltas P^-1 W P, with immutable source TRS and separate display offsets.

composition.policy: Merge only declared disjoint ownedIds from full-reset pose maps. Derive all angles from one seekable story time; no integration or independent clock.

gear.ratioDiscrepancy: The retained STEP geometry has 96/24/144/156 teeth. Ideal kinematics derives -31.5:1. The upstream README publishes 34:1; that discrepancy is unresolved and is not silently forced into the model.
gear.attachmentTopology: Manual steps 6–7 key both inner ring gears into the two outer rings and bolt the outer rings together. Steps 9–10 mesh the front/back plates with the planet ends. Usage fixes the plates and attaches loads to the outer rings. Both named inner rings are output members.
gear.coordinateMeaning: Positive rotation is right-handed about source motor-shaft axis [0,-1,0]. Orbit is a virtual coordinate; no physical planet carrier is added. Planet world spin equals -44/21 input, and spin relative to orbit equals -52/21 input.
gear.sourcePhasePolicy: Keep every original source tooth phase; apply only world delta transforms. Planet orbit and own-axis spin are composed before source placement.
gear.bearingPolicy: Only the two named outer-ring leaves belong to this gear adapter. Rolling elements and other bearing race parts require the independent bearing adapter; they are not driven here.
limitations: Ideal rigid kinematics, not recovered STEP mates.
Tessellated section counts and sampled nonpenetration do not certify 3D contact or manufacturing clearance.
No torque, friction, deformation, dynamic load, backlash or lubrication model.
Source geometric planet centres are an explicit mesh-based axis approximation.

demonstration.easing: quintic smoothstep on each leg; return to exact zero before parts reopen
demonstration.bearings: Both bearing outer races follow the derived gearbox output during this passage.

bearing.model: Ideal no-slip crossed-roller bearing; geometry-bound kinematics, not recovered CAD mates or a contact/load simulation
bearing.innerRacePolicy: Part 59 rests on the fixed front/back plate; source manual step 11 and matching inner mounting pattern.
bearing.outerRacePolicy: Part 69 follows the output outer-ring support; source manual steps 6, 7 and 11. Both outer-race halves are represented by one source occurrence and are never split synthetically.
bearing.cagePolicy: Part 62 follows cage angle. Exactly 66 original source rollers per side orbit with the cage and spin about their measured alternating 45-degree axes.
limitations: 10-micrometre source rolling clearance is neglected for ideal no-slip motion.
The imported bearing is source-triangulated AP242 geometry, not an analytic solid/contact model.
No elastic deformation, preload, lubrication, slip, force, collision or load-life calculation.
Support rings are excluded from this rig and belong to the gearbox output motion owner.

demonstration.easing: quintic smoothstep on each leg; return to exact zero before local bearing teardown
demonstration.interpretation: An isolated bearing observation drives its outer race independently while the rest of the transmission is hidden; it is not a claim of simultaneous whole-transmission operation.

workingMotion.resetPolicy: Gear angle is zero at beat39; isolated bearing angle is zero at beat102. Zero-angle model identity persists through final reassembly and loop. No arbitrary one-revolution reset is used.

presentation.envelopeMethod: Existing whole/local/focus envelope plus combined real gear/roller transformed source AABBs and current display offsets at 49 samples in each new mechanical passage. This is an observation envelope, not collision proof.
presentation.opacity: Gear context fades while gathering; fixed toothed plates remain faint for orientation. Gear view fades at39–41 before scatter41–44 and motor fade-in. Bearing outer race/support become transparent for the roller view; the cage remains faint. Visibility changes do not remove mechanical load paths.
presentation.annotationWindowCoordinates: Seconds relative to the corresponding chapter. New mechanical chapters have no moving-target leader labels. Existing study cues use the remapped base state.
presentation.typography: Shared atlas-serif study style; capture profile uses36px annotations/body and46px chapter headings at1920x1080. CSS remains the typography authority.
presentation.macroType: One actual occurrence moves out and returns; camera magnification changes viewing scale, not geometry.

music.authorship: Original Mechanism Studio extended composition, deterministic synthesis and editorial effects. Established warm synthesis voices, one new complete arrangement. No third-party samples, service calls or recordings.
music.style: Gentle keys, warm pads and restrained bass, continuous through whole assembly, motor, bearing and return. Two source-part close-ups receive quieter reading space. No drum bed, narration or label dings.
music.clock: One continuous PCM buffer; no segment resets or narration API.
music.effectPolicy: Motion-event cues are editorial synthesis. Gear and roller motion has music only; no recorded or physically solved contact sound is claimed.

limits: The retained CAD derives a reverse31.5:1 gear ratio while the upstream README states34:1; discrepancy remains unresolved.
Source tooth phases and original identities are preserved. Sampled tessellated sections support kinematics but do not certify continuous3D tooth contact or exact manufacturing clearance.
The crossed-roller model is ideal no-slip and neglects the source10-micrometre rolling clearance; the imported bearing is triangulated source geometry.
No recovered CAD mates, contact force, preload, slip, backlash, friction, deformation, torque, dynamics, fatigue or load-life simulation.
Internal motor co-rotation remains an explicitly authored mechanical interpretation.
Display explosion and single-part excursions are editorial, not service procedures or collision-checked dismantling.
Bound manifest generation, automated tests, actual browser playback and encoded-video review are separate evidence; this file does not declare a completed video export.
